name: Emily Randall
bio: a Representative from Washington; born in Port Orchard, Kitsap County, Wash., October 30, 1985; graduated from South Kitsap High School, Port Orchard, Wash., 2004; B.A., Wellesley College, Wellesley, Mass., 2008; staff, Wellesley College, Wellesley, Mass., 2010-2015; public advocate; member of the Washington state senate, 2019-2024, deputy majority leader, 2023-2024; elected as a Democrat to the One Hundred Nineteenth Congress (January 3, 2025-present).
